description: Break an approved ZeroTrace spec into ordered, verifiable tasks.

Use `zerotrace-development-loop` and `planning-and-task-breakdown`. Confirm the spec is approved; inspect relevant code read-only. Produce dependency order, risks, checkpoints, task IDs, 1–5-file scope, acceptance tests and exact repo commands. Update `tasks/plan.md` and `tasks/todo.md` only if they do not contain unrelated unfinished work. Do not write product code. Present the plan and wait for explicit human approval.
